audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot priestly garment construction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for priestly garments, ephod, stones, breastpiece, robe, tunics, gold plate, completion formula, Moses' inspection and blessing.

verses.restored: From blue, purple, and scarlet they made woven garments for ministering in holy place, and made holy garments for Aaron, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: וּמִן הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He made ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen.

familiar.text: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

modern.text: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

original.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר

verses.restored: They hammered sheets of gold and cut threads to work into blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen, work of skilled designer.

familiar.text: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

modern.text: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.

original.text: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּת֤וֹךְ הַתְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּבְת֣וֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְת֣וֹךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב

verses.restored: They made shoulder pieces for it, joined; at its two ends it was joined.

familiar.text: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

modern.text: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

original.text: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ ל֖וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל שְׁנֵ֥י קצוותו חֻבָּֽר

verses.restored: Skillfully woven band that was on it was from it, like its work: gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: They made onyx stones set in gold filigree, engraved as signet engravings with names of sons of Israel.

familiar.text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

modern.text: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He put them on shoulder pieces of ephod as stones of remembrance for children of Israel, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus 28:15–30)

original.text: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He made breastpiece, work of skilled designer, like work of ephod: gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen.

familiar.text: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

modern.text: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.

original.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר

verses.restored: It was square; they made breastpiece doubled, a span its length and a span its width, doubled.

familiar.text: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

modern.text: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.

original.text: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכּ֛וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּ֖וֹ כָּפֽוּל

verses.restored: They filled it with four rows of stones: row of carnelian, topaz, emerald, first row;

familiar.text: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

modern.text: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;

original.text: וַיְמַלְאוּ ב֔וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: second row: turquoise, sapphire, and diamond/clear stone;

familiar.text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

modern.text: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;

original.text: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם

verses.restored: third row: jacinth, agate, and amethyst;

familiar.text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

modern.text: the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

original.text: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה

verses.restored: fourth row: beryl, onyx, and jasper, set in gold filigree in their settings.

familiar.text: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

modern.text: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.

original.text: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם

verses.restored: The stones were according to names of sons of Israel, twelve according to their names, engravings of signet, each according to its name for twelve tribes.

familiar.text: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

modern.text: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

original.text: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל שְׁמ֔וֹ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט

verses.restored: They made on breastpiece chains of corded work, twisted cords of pure gold.

familiar.text: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

modern.text: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.

original.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר

verses.restored: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and put two rings on two ends of breastpiece.

familiar.text: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

modern.text: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: They put two gold cords on two rings at ends of breastpiece.

familiar.text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

modern.text: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: Two ends of two cords they put on two settings, and put them on shoulder pieces of ephod, toward its front.

familiar.text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

modern.text: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

original.text: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו

verses.restored: They made two gold rings and put them on two ends of breastpiece, on its edge that was toward inner side of ephod.

familiar.text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

modern.text: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה

verses.restored: They made two gold rings and put them on two shoulder pieces of ephod below, toward its front, close to its joining, above woven band of ephod.

familiar.text: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

modern.text: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְמַ֨טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד

verses.restored: They bound breastpiece by its rings to rings of ephod with blue cord, so it was above woven band of ephod and breastpiece did not move from ephod, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Additional Priestly Garments (Exodus 28:31–43)

original.text: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He made robe of ephod, work of weaver, all blue.

familiar.text: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

modern.text: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,

original.text: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת

verses.restored: Opening of robe in its middle was like opening of coat of mail, with binding around opening, so it would not tear.

familiar.text: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

modern.text: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.

original.text: וּפִֽי הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתוֹכ֖וֹ כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ

verses.restored: They made on hem of robe pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet, twisted.

familiar.text: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

modern.text: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר

verses.restored: They made bells of pure gold and put bells among pomegranates on hem of robe all around, among pomegranates:

familiar.text: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

modern.text: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,

original.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּת֖וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים

verses.restored: bell and pomegranate, bell and pomegranate, around hem of robe for ministering, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: They made tunics of fine linen, work of weaver, for Aaron and his sons,

familiar.text: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

modern.text: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver,

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת הַכָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו

verses.restored: and turban of fine linen, beautiful caps of fine linen, linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,

familiar.text: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

modern.text: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,

original.text: וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר

verses.restored: and sash of fine twisted linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, work of embroiderer, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: וְֽאֶת הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: They made plate of holy crown of pure gold and wrote upon it writing of signet engraving: Holy to YHWH.

familiar.text: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

modern.text: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: They put on it blue cord, to put it on turban above, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Moses Approves the Work

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: All work of dwelling-place of tent of meeting was completed; children of Israel did according to all that YHWH commanded Moses, so they did.

familiar.text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

modern.text: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כָּל עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: They brought dwelling-place to Moses: tent and all its vessels, clasps, frames, bars, pillars, and bases;

familiar.text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

modern.text: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent with all its furnishings, its clasps, its frames, its crossbars, and its posts and bases;

original.text: וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת הָאֹ֖הֶל וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו קְרָסָ֣יו קְרָשָׁ֔יו בריחו וְעַמֻּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו

verses.restored: covering of reddened ram skins, covering of durable hides, and veil of screen;

familiar.text: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

modern.text: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering;

original.text: וְאֶת מִכְסֵ֞ה עוֹרֹ֤ת הָֽאֵילִם֙ הַמְאָדָּמִ֔ים וְאֶת מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַתְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ

verses.restored: ark of testimony, its poles, and cover;

familiar.text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

modern.text: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;

original.text: אֶת אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻ֖ת וְאֶת בַּדָּ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת

verses.restored: table, all its vessels, and bread of presence/faces;

familiar.text: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

modern.text: the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence;

original.text: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים

verses.restored: pure lampstand, its lamps, lamps arranged, all its vessels, and oil for light;

familiar.text: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

modern.text: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its utensils, as well as the oil for the light;

original.text: אֶת הַמְּנֹרָ֨ה הַטְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֗יהָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר

verses.restored: gold altar, anointing oil, fragrant incense, and screen of entrance of tent;

familiar.text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

modern.text: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

original.text: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל

verses.restored: bronze altar, its bronze grating, poles, and all its vessels, basin and its stand;

familiar.text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

modern.text: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

original.text: אֵ֣ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔וֹ אֶת בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ

verses.restored: hangings of court, its pillars and bases, screen for gate of court, its cords and pegs, and all vessels for service of dwelling-place, for tent of meeting;

familiar.text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

modern.text: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

original.text: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֶת עַמֻּדֶ֣יהָ וְאֶת אֲדָנֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת הַמָּסָךְ֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֶת מֵיתָרָ֖יו וִיתֵדֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֗ת כָּל כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: woven garments for ministering in holy place, holy garments for Aaron the priest, and garments of his sons to serve as priests.

familiar.text: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

modern.text: and the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.

original.text: אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן

verses.restored: According to all that YHWH commanded Moses, so children of Israel did all the work.

familiar.text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

modern.text: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל הָעֲבֹדָֽה

verses.restored: Moses saw all the work, and look, they had done it; as YHWH commanded, so they had done. And Moses blessed them.

familiar.text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

modern.text: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

original.text: וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת כָּל הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה

translation_notes: Repeated 'as YHWH commanded Moses' emphasizes faithful completion of the pattern.
Priestly garments again carry Israel's names for remembrance and heart-bearing.
Gold threads woven into fabric show metal transformed into textile artistry.
Moses inspects and blesses completed work; sacred craft receives blessing, not exploitation.
safety_note: Completion of sacred work leads to blessing, not further extraction. The artisans and congregation are honored for doing as commanded.
